items.content_html: A lightweight, production-ready NPM package for generating text embeddings locally using @xenova/transformers. Supports MiniLM and BGE models with 384-dimensional vectors. Features include batch processing, similarity functions (cosine, euclidean, dot product), and built-in benchmarking tools. No external API calls required - runs entirely in Node.
